biological_question: Are frozen ligand-positive sender and receptor-positive receiver cells spatially enriched beyond family location, RNA depth and local cell density in existing tissues?

geometry.coordinates: v3 cache coords / converter .12028 reconstructs native pixels; independent absolute micron calibration is unverified
geometry.cell_radius: sqrt(native Area / pi) in pixels, a circular area proxy not actual cell boundary
geometry.tissue_mask: No reviewed tissue mask; finite radius avoids unbounded nearest-neighbour bridging but cannot remove all holes
geometry.density: Degree on the primary geometry graph of all QC native cells in the same FOV; calculated before candidate expression

primary_identity: Accepted v3 qc_background_author: same author broad T/B, native QC, family name and all LR components above FOV negative-probe q95; author absence is missing. ICON B category and GSE287472 author unavailable.

null.strata: Within each FOV: joint sender/receiver family membership (10/01/11), native RNA above/below median of all QC FOV cells, local primary degree above/below median of all QC FOV cells
null.permutation: Shuffle joint two-bit L-positive/R-positive code within each fixed stratum, preserving family locations, all stratum-specific L/R counts and same-cell coexpression. Same cell never contributes to adjacency. A stratum of size1 or constant code is preserved; no automatic bin merging.
null.statistic: Sum directed ligand-positive sender to receptor-positive receiver neighbour pairs across all FOVs within a file. Constant family graph and endpoint denominator; no FOV treated as independent patient.
null.pvalue: One-sided enrichment (1+null>=observed)/(2001), depletion and two-sided diagnostic separately. No test when required gene/author unavailable, no endpoints or zero primary null variance.
null.BH: Primary enrichment p: BH over all45 predefined interface-file tests, unavailable/unestimable p filled1 solely inside multiplicity calculation; reported p remains NA.
null.sensitivity: Same 2000 primary permutations score radii1/3; p diagnostic, no new BH family or result-selected radius. RNA-marker/background/pure and count>=2 endpoint/observed geometry sensitivity reported without selecting a replacement primary.

power: No >=20 perFOV eligibility gate for this conditional test. All measured sparse interfaces retained, endpoint and movable count, null variance, FOV concentration and leave-one-FOV enrichment summaries reported. >=20 was preflight descriptive coverage only.
units: Conditional spatial label tests within observed FOVs; no patient/core map => no patient population significance, no independent cross-source validation. TMA files from one GSE may share people.
interpretation: Spatial RNA organization, not protein engagement, downstream response or CM driver. Keep source/cancer limited and cross-cancer transfer valuable but distinct.

binding_limits.LGALS9|CD44: Primary functional binding literature; glycan and cell context unmeasured
binding_limits.LGALS9|PTPRC: Glycan/protein association with CD45, broader receptor complexes; not exclusive canonical signal
binding_limits.IL16|CD4: Primary CD4 domain binding/function evidence; molecular context requires qualification
binding_limits.IL16|CD9: Primary alternate binding receptor evidence mainly mast cells, does not validate current B-to-T direction
binding_limits.HLA-DRA|CD4: Full peptide-MHC-II complex and TCR context required; DRA RNA alone is proxy
binding_limits.APP|NOTCH2: Primary same-cell association, not established trans-cell activating ligand here
binding_limits.SELPLG|SELL: Adhesion interaction requires glycosylation/sulfation not measured by RNA
binding_limits.CD55|ADGRE5: Direct extracellular interaction, current cell-direction function untested
binding_limits.TNFSF10|TNFRSF10B: Direct TRAIL/DR5 receptor evidence, trimerization and cellular death response unmeasured

acceptance: All9 unique interfaces x5 files exactly45; 65 mapped records with no duplicated evidence
Parent hashes and every private cache locked/verified; canonical inputs unchanged
Independent graph recount and small brute-force distance fixtures; no self/cross-FOV edges
Independent endpoint/overlap/strata/null replay across all45; all unavailable cases retained
All2000 null draws and invariants retained privately; public aggregates only; semantic audit separates computational from patient/mechanism validation
